 Use Prediction Markets for Philadelphia 76ers vs. Cleveland Cavaliers
 The 8-1 Philadelphia 76ers bring a stifling 103.1 defensive rating that allows just 105.2 points per game against the 4-4 Cleveland Cavaliers. Cleveland counters with an offense averaging 119.2 points, but their own defense leaks 117.1 points nightly.
 Cleveland faces interior issues with center Jarrett Allen questionable due to a knee injury. His potential absence would severely shift rebounding and interior prop markets, while Philadelphia is missing only minor depth pieces like Dominick Barlow.
 This rotational stability reflects in the metrics, as the 76ers boast a 6-3 ATS record and hit the under 77.8% of the time, dwarfing Cleveland’s sluggish 2-6 ATS mark. Given Philadelphia’s elite defensive profile and superior spread success, the market’s decision to favor the road team with a 56% implied probability is entirely justified.
